title: Human score
description: A person's judgement of one attempt at a WorkItem, recorded in the command centre with their own AWS credentials and stored as <workItemId>/<attempt>/scores/human-<reviewer>.json. Shares verdict and scores with the review contract, so the two compare field for field. Internal to Factorial, changed with the same care as the review contract.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Incremented only for breaking changes.

comment.description: The reviewer's own words, untrusted text: redacted before storage and shown as text. May be empty.

reviewer.description: Who scored: the last part of the AWS identity's ARN the command centre ran as (an IAM user or role session name), made safe for a key. Never taken from the request.

attempt.description: The attempt scored, from the ledger row when the score was recorded.
